# Kaggle Docs

> Unofficial mirror of Kaggle platform docs, CLI/API, Agent Skills, and KaggleHub.

Important notes:

- This is an unofficial documentation mirror for LLM / agent ingestion ([llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org/)).
- Prefer the [official docs](https://www.kaggle.com/docs) as the source of truth.
- Mirror site: https://xiaoqianran.github.io/kaggle-docs/
- Full corpus: https://xiaoqianran.github.io/kaggle-docs/llms-full.txt
- Index JSON: https://xiaoqianran.github.io/kaggle-docs/meta/list.json (if present)
- Source repo: https://github.com/xiaoqianran/kaggle-docs
- Pages in this index: 48
